title: Per-frame UNDEFINED -> depth-attachment transition of the shared depth image uses TOP_OF_PIPE / no access as its source scope with two frames in flight
expected_finding: each frame's command buffer transitions depthImage UNDEFINED -> DEPTH_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL with srcStage TOP_OF_PIPE and srcAccess 0; with two frames in flight the previous frame's depth writes (EARLY/LATE_FRAGMENT_TESTS, DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE) to the same image are not in the source scope, so the layout transition and this frame's depth clear are write-after-write against them
